providers.viewOnly: You can see the doctors and clinics but not change them.

empty.title: Your baby's doctors, in one place
empty.body: Save the pediatrician, specialists and clinics once, with phone, address and registration. When you schedule an appointment, pick one and the doctor and place fill in on their own.
empty.bodyReadOnly: Nothing saved yet. A parent can add the baby's doctors and clinics here.

address.label: Find the address
address.help: Type a postal code (CEP) or a street or place name, then press Find address. Only what you type is sent, never anything about your baby.
address.placeholder: e.g. 01001-000 or Rua Augusta, São Paulo
address.tooShort: Type a CEP or at least 3 characters to search.
address.offline: You are offline, so the address can't be looked up. Type it below.
address.manual: You can type the address below.
address.filled: Address filled in below. Add the number and complement, and check it.

sheet.name: Name
sheet.nameRequired: Enter a name of up to 80 characters.
sheet.notesHelp: Contact details only. The baby's health information goes in the baby's own records.

detail.deletedNotice: {{name}} deleted. Appointments keep what they copied.

picker.label: Doctor or clinic
picker.help: Pick a saved one to fill in the doctor and the place. You can still edit them below.
picker.more_one: {{count}} more: keep typing to narrow down.
picker.more_other: {{count}} more: keep typing to narrow down.
picker.removed: A saved doctor that is no longer on the list
